tasks.prompt: Fix Runner.run in retry.py so repeat calls with the same operation ID return the previous successful result without repeating the side effect. Cache falsey results, including None. Different IDs remain independent. Exceptions propagate and failed operations can be retried. This is synchronous and in memory; no concurrency or persistence is required. Preserve the API and README.md.

Extend settings.py reconcile(path) to set managed.retry_limit to 3 while keeping managed.enabled true. Only these two nested keys are owned: preserve unknown keys, including unknown keys inside managed. Valid input is a JSON object whose managed field, if present, is an object. Repeated runs must be idempotent. Malformed JSON must raise JSONDecodeError and leave the file unchanged. Preserve the API and README.md.

Refactor parser.py parse_pair(left, right) to remove duplicate validation and trimming while preserving behavior. Preserve return values, exception types and messages, and left-before-right evaluation order, including str subclasses. Do not change the API or README.md or add dependencies. The function already works; this is a readability cleanup.

Fix paginate(items, page, per_page) in pages.py. Pages are 1-based: page 1 holds the first per_page items. Return a dict with items (a list), page, total_pages and has_next. An empty sequence has one empty page. A page past the end returns no items. page and per_page must be positive integers; raise ValueError otherwise. Do not change the input. Preserve README.md.

Make to_csv(rows) in export.py produce CSV that spreadsheets read correctly: quote fields that need it, end every row with CRLF, and write None as an empty field. Guard against formula injection by prefixing text that starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return with a single quote; numbers stay as they are. No rows give an empty string. Keep the signature, the standard library only, and README.md.
